moves.description: Luke Kennard and a Swap 2026 2nd round picks were acquired by the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for Danny Green, a More Favorable 2024 2nd round pick, a 2024 2nd round pick (TOR own) and a 2027 2nd round pick (MEM own). Danny Green, John Wall, a Swap 2023 1st round picks and a TPE were acquired by the Houston Rockets in exchange for Eric Gordon. Eric Gordon, a More Favorable 2024 2nd round pick, a 2024 2nd round pick (TOR own) and a 2027 2nd round pick (MEM own) were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for Luke Kennard, John Wall, a Swap 2023 1st round picks and a Swap 2026 2nd round picks.

moves.label: Trade: K.J. Martin, Vanja Marinkovic, Josh Christopher, Vanja Marinkovic, Dillon Brooks and others
moves.description: K.J. Martin and a Swap 2026 2nd round picks were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic, a 2027 2nd round pick (MEM own) and a TPE. Josh Christopher, the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic and a TPE were acquired by the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for Dillon Brooks. Dillon Brooks, the draft rights to Alpha Kaba and a 2027 2nd round pick (MEM own) were acquired by the Houston Rockets in exchange for Josh Christopher, Usman Garuba, K.J. Martin, Patty Mills, TyTy Washington, Jr., a 2024 2nd round pick (HOU own), a 2025 2nd round pick (MIN own), a Swap 2026 2nd round picks, a 2028 2nd round pick (HOU own), a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own) and a 2030 2nd round pick (HOU own). Patty Mills, a 2024 2nd round pick (HOU own), a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own) and a 2030 2nd round pick (HOU own) were acquired by the Oklahoma City Thunder in exchange for cash. Usman Garuba, TyTy Washington, Jr., a 2025 2nd round pick (MIN own), a 2028 2nd round pick (HOU own) and cash were acquired by the Atlanta Hawks in exchange for the draft rights to Alpha Kaba and multiple TPEs.

moves.label: Trade: Isaiah Todd

moves.label: Trade: John Collins, Santi Aldama, Marcus Sasser, Tarik Biberovic, A.J. Johnson and others
moves.description: A conditional 2030 2nd round pick (DET own) and a TPE were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for John Collins and cash. Santi Aldama, Marcus Sasser and the draft rights to Tarik Biberovic were acquired by the Dallas Mavericks in exchange for A.J. Johnson, Khris Middleton, a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own), a conditional 2030 1st round pick (GOS own) and a 2033 2nd round pick (DAL own). Khris Middleton, a 2033 2nd round pick (DAL own) and a TPE were acquired by the Washington Wizards in exchange for D'Angelo Russell, a 2029 2nd round pick (LAL own), a Swap 2032 2nd round picks, a 2033 2nd round pick (WAS own) and a TPE. Caris LeVert, a 2027 2nd round pick (MIL own) and cash were acquired by the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for Gary Harris and Taurean Prince. A.J. Johnson, D'Angelo Russell, Isaiah Stewart II, a 2029 2nd round pick (LAL own), a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own), a conditional 2030 1st round pick (GOS own), a Swap 2032 2nd round picks and a 2033 2nd round pick (WAS own) were acquired by the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for Santi Aldama, the draft rights to Tarik Biberovic, a 2029 2nd round pick (DET own), a 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own) and a 2032 2nd round pick (DET own). John Collins, Gary Harris, Taurean Prince, a Least Favorable 2027 2nd round pick, a 2029 2nd round pick (DET own), a 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own), a 2032 2nd round pick (DET own) and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Detroit Pistons in exchange for Caris LeVert, Marcus Sasser, Isaiah Stewart II, a Least Favorable 2027 2nd round pick, a 2027 2nd round pick (MIL own) and a conditional 2030 2nd round pick (DET own).

assumptions: First-round forfeitures are excluded before the lottery. Under the new system, keep the remaining relegated teams’ No.12floor and origin-based repeat-pick restrictions. Second-round ordering uses the full30-origin counterfactual lottery. This forfeiture interaction is a modeling assumption pending a detailed NBA procedure.
For2030andlater, continue the latest announced lottery system; the NBA has not yet determined those rules.
Reported most-favorable DET-held2028right, top55protected; physicalDET56–60is already owedPHI and is never reassigned.
Top-N second-round protections use actual overall numbers, including a second-round selection atNo.30 after a first-round forfeiture.
Reconstructed career-path pick prices use the fixed current endpoint-trained model and the last archived strength/standings forecast dated 2026-09-30; legal rights are dated 2026-09-30.
Historical injury coverage uses reviewed major absence reports; it is not a complete archive of short-term medical reports.

assumptions: First-round forfeitures are excluded before the lottery. Under the new system, keep the remaining relegated teams’ No.12floor and origin-based repeat-pick restrictions. Second-round ordering uses the full30-origin counterfactual lottery. This forfeiture interaction is a modeling assumption pending a detailed NBA procedure.
For2030andlater, continue the latest announced lottery system; the NBA has not yet determined those rules.
Reported most-favorable DET-held2028right, top55protected; physicalDET56–60is already owedPHI and is never reassigned.
Top-N second-round protections use actual overall numbers, including a second-round selection atNo.30 after a first-round forfeiture.
Reconstructed career-path pick prices use the fixed current endpoint-trained model and the last archived strength/standings forecast dated 2026-10-25; legal rights are dated 2026-10-31.
Historical injury coverage uses reviewed major absence reports; it is not a complete archive of short-term medical reports.
